paragraphs: 7 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Saturday for 7 clubs across 4 levels, with Alejandro Garza producing the night's most notable performance.
Alejandro Garza tied the game in the fifth with a sacrifice fly to right field on a 2-2 pitch from Jose Bello, changing the score from 1-2 to 2-2.
He batted second and started at second base.
Hill City Howlers fell to Salem RidgeYaks, 5-6.

Steven Brooks came on in relief for Portland Sea Dogs in the bottom of the sixth with nobody out. He worked 2 1/3 innings, allowing 0 hits and 0 earned runs, with 1 walk and 4 strikeouts. One of his strikeouts came in the sixth on a 2-2 pitch, when he put away Victor Figueroa. Portland Sea Dogs beat Chesapeake Baysox, 6-4.

Bryce Warrecker came on in relief for Hudson Valley Renegades in the bottom of the third with nobody out. He worked 3.0 innings, allowing 2 hits and 0 earned runs, with 2 walks and 4 strikeouts. One of his strikeouts came in the third on a 0-2 pitch, when he put away Teo Banks. Hudson Valley Renegades fell to Wilmington Blue Rocks, 3-5.

Brooks Lee went 1-for-4, 1 double, 1 RBI for Minnesota Twins. Brooks Lee drove in his lone run with a double in the fourth to left field on a 1-2 96 mph four-seam fastball from Anthony Kay. He batted seventh and started at third base. Minnesota Twins beat Chicago White Sox, 6-4.
Ryan Stafford went 0-for-2, 1 run scored, 2 walks for Frederick Keys at High-A. He batted ninth and started behind the plate. Frederick Keys beat Brooklyn Cyclones, 7-3.

Ryan Tayman appeared defensively for St. Lucie Mets against Jupiter Hammerheads for St. Lucie Mets at Single-A. He batted fourth and started behind the plate. St. Lucie Mets and Jupiter Hammerheads finished 1-1.
Zach Daudet went 0-for-4 for Asheville Tourists at High-A. He batted seventh and started at shortstop. Asheville Tourists fell to Greensboro Grasshoppers, 4-11.
title: Alejandro Garza delivers in a key spot
